title: Remediated D4 charge-source public-contract compatibility audit
question: Does the remediated Lab 004 d4_charge.py remain behaviorally compatible with the frozen Lab 005 public adapter contract when only the stale source-hash guard is bypassed in memory?
scope: Deterministic public-contract replay only. The old source body is unavailable, so this audit can establish public behavioral compatibility but cannot claim line-level or internal-algorithm equivalence.
intervention: In the pytest process only, require the old and current hashes to match their registered values, then replace exactly _POLICY_SOURCE_HASHES['d4_charge.py'] with the current hash. No source or manifest is mutated by the test plugin.
compatibility_dimensions: public function signatures and exact field sets
flux correction syndrome fidelity for sizes 2 and 3
causal temporal ordering and deterministic replay
matched syndrome-only/heralded execution across all four schedules
ground-state-relative winding and private scorer boundary
acceptance: All selected legacy Lab 005 public-contract tests and remediated Lab 004 public-interface tests pass with exactly one in-memory hash override; source hashes match; zero production histories or performance evaluations are produced.
stop_rule: On any failed test or unexpected hash, classify the public contract as incompatible and remediate the adapter. On pass, authorize only a later disk hash update and rerun of the unchanged J1-E4B matrix.
compute_budget: One deterministic pytest compatibility suite; no sampling, bootstrap, performance metric or threshold analysis.

outcome.decision: Authorize a later update of only the Lab 005 d4_charge.py frozen hash and rerun the unchanged J1-E4B matrix.
